svg.title: Modality horizontal lockup
svg.desc: Trident-M mark beside the Modality wordmark. NOTE: the wordmark renders in live text (Newsreader/serif). For print or the trademark specimen, convert the text to outlines in a vector editor so it is font-independent.

text.font-family: Newsreader, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif
